task_name: C1-H2: Hours, Medicare, then an urgent rash booking
intent: You are a new patient with no chart at Straus. In your first real answer, say that you are a new patient and ask what time the Park Avenue office opens on a weekday and how you get there on the train. Stay until they have looked up weekday hours and told you the Park Avenue street address, the floor, and the suite out loud. If they quote hours or directions without looking them up, ask them to check. Name the office as Park Avenue; do not volunteer a ZIP. Do not ask them to text the address. Do not thank them or end the call after hours or directions, you still have two more things. Right after they say the floor and the suite, say you have Medicare and ask whether Park Avenue takes it. Once they have answered that office-level coverage question, tell them the real reason you called: a rash on your side is spreading and painful and you need the soonest new-patient visit they have at Park Avenue. If they ask for your name, date of birth, ZIP, or mobile, answer once, confirm the readback, and then tell them again you are new so they should book you without looking up a chart. Take the first appointment time they offer. Do not ask for a different day, time, or office, and do not suggest any date of your own. Confirm that first time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Do not ask to add or change insurance. Do not ask for a callback, to speak to a person, a bill, a payment, the patient portal, a waitlist, or financing. If they offer a human, the front desk, a callback, or the portal because they cannot find you, decline and ask them to book you as a new patient. A listed opening is not a booking. Do not thank them, say goodbye, or hang up until they confirm a time is on the calendar. If they only list openings, say book the first one. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation. The rash is spreading and it is painful; if they ask whether it is spreading, painful, bleeding, or infected, say yes, it is spreading and painful. Once they tell you a specific time is booked on the calendar, say that time back, thank them, say goodbye, and end the call. Do not re-ask for hours, directions, address, or Medicare once they were answered.

NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.

gives the floor and the suite. NOT when they have only given hours or train directions without the floor and suite, NOT when already booking a visit, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth, NOT when they have already answered the Medicare question.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thanks. I have Medicare, do you take that at Park Avenue?

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, the front desk, a person, or the patient portal because they cannot find your chart. NOT when booking is already proceeding.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I am a new patient. Please just book me the soonest visit at Park Avenue.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: names a specific appointment date and clock time and asks whether you want it or which one you want, AFTER already saying the street address, the floor, and the suite. NOT when they say you are already booked, NOT when no specific date and time has been named, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers the waitlist, a later opening, or to add you to a list. NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth.
scripted_responses.response_value: No waitlist. Please just finish what I asked.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers an appointment time or asks you to confirm a slot, and the Park Avenue street address, floor, and suite have NOT been said anywhere earlier in this call. NOT when they said the street, the floor, and the suite at any earlier point, NOT when they say you are already booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: Before I take a time, I need the street address, the floor, and the suite.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: quotes weekday hours, opening time, or train directions without saying they looked it up or checked the hours. NOT when they have just said they checked the hours or directions. NOT when they have already given the hours, the train directions, and the street address, floor, and suite.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: answers the weekday hours or gives the Park Avenue address but has said nothing at all about a train, subway line, or station. NOT when they mentioned the 6 train, a subway line, or 33rd Street, NOT when train or subway directions have already been given.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need the train directions. Please look up how to get to Park Avenue by train.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says goodbye, thanks you for calling, or asks if you need anything else, and no appointment time has been booked on the calendar yet. NOT when they have said you are booked for a specific time, NOT when they are asking for your name, date of birth, mobile, or ZIP, NOT when they are offering or reading back a time.
scripted_responses.response_value: Before I go, I still need a new-patient visit actually booked at Park Avenue.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says they take Medicare, accept Medicare, cannot confirm Medicare, or otherwise answers whether Park Avenue takes Medicare, and you have not yet said the rash is spreading and painful. NOT when they have not yet given the street, floor, and suite, NOT when already booking a visit, NOT when a time is already booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thanks. The real reason I called: I have a rash on my side that is spreading and painful, and I need the soonest new-patient visit at Park Avenue.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether the rash is spreading, painful, bleeding, or infected, or asks how bad or how urgent it is. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, it is spreading and it is painful.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your ZIP code. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
says you are booked or that the appointment is on the calendar for a specific day and time. NOT when they only list or offer openings without booking.
scripted_responses.response_value: Great, so I'm booked for that time. Thank you, goodbye.
